svg.text: Direct-return baseline | each branch is individually isolatable and balanceable | diagram is schematic, not to scale
DC-HYD-02 | R1 | 23 OCT 2026 | Concept for review; not construction documentation
SUPPLY FROM SHEET 01 -> H-101 | 35 C | 125 mm clear ID
RETURN TO SHEET 01 <- H-102 | nominal 45 C | 125 mm clear ID
Each rack design target: 2.412 L/s = 144.7 L/min. Branch clear ID: 40 mm. Equal heat loads do not guarantee equal flow.
IV = isolation valve | FI = flow indication | BV = balancing valve | AV = air vent. Ports / QDs at rack connection: vendor selection pending.
Critical-rack differential pressure uses supply and return taps; control sensor placement is checked in the OpenModelica network.
Initial rack internal loss: assumed 100 kPa at design flow. Actual rack curves, fitting losses and valve settings are not yet selected.
